subject: Long-window profiles + dollar-per-M follow-up: 8k / 32k / 128k mix
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@aeroscale.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + data ask: context mix / avg tokens / target $/1M

Alex — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a small data ask so we can put together a pricing sketch that matches AeroScale's unit-econ goals. Attached: short post-call notes.

Key points I captured:
- Primary use: multi-turn summarization + RAG + policy-safe generation for customer support transcripts.
- Target throughput: steady-state, not bursty — looking to model 50–100M tokens / month initially.
- Latency requirement: interactive (< 1.2s for most flows), but background batch jobs can tolerate higher latency.
- Long-context needs: you mentioned some flows need company history (~32k) and a tiny fraction include entire quarterly transcripts (~128k).

Data we need (can be ballpark):
1) Avg prompt tokens per request (prompt = user + context + metadata)
2) Avg completion tokens per request
3) Monthly token volume (total or per-flow) and growth target
4) Percent of requests that need: <=8k context, 8k-32k, 32k-128k, >128k (if any)
5) Any target cost per $/1M tokens you have in mind (we often use this to align model and hosting options)

Next steps from our side once we have the numbers:
- Provide 3 pricing profiles (hosted API, dedicated block, private node) with expected $/1M by context band.
- Recommended model families and quantization/latency tradeoffs for your mix.
- Quick ROI sketch (cost vs quality) and a pilot recommendation.

Would you be able to share the ballpark numbers above? If it's easier, reply inline and we can iterate.

Attachments: aeroscale-postcall-notes.pdf (1 page)

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
O: (415) 555-0132 | tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@aeroscale.io>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + data ask: context mix / avg tokens / target $/1M

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the clear list. See ballpark numbers below (these are from our internal telemetry over the last 30 days). I'm copying salesops for any procurement notes.

- Avg prompt tokens: 420 tokens (this includes the RAG context we attach; median ~300)
- Avg completion tokens: 1,200 tokens (we generate fairly verbose summaries)
- Monthly token volume: ~75,000,000 tokens / month today, planning to hit ~150M in 6 months if pilot goes well
- Context distribution by request:
  * <=8k: 85%
  * 8k–32k: 9.5%
  * 32k–128k: 0.4%
  * >128k: 0% (we slice rather than send >128k currently)

Target unit economics: we were hoping to sit around $700–900 per 1M tokens for the blended mix. If you have model/hosting combos that get us under $800/1M with equivalent quality, that would be ideal.

Attached is a sanitized internal cost model that shows our breakpoints (aeroscale-internal-cost-model.xlsx). Happy to jump on a follow-up tech deep-dive next week — Tue/Wed mornings PT work best.

Best,
Alex Wu
Head of ML Platforms — AeroScale
alex.wu@aeroscale.io | +1 (206) 555-0228

Short internal note after Alex's numbers — pulling a quick priced sketch we can send as a follow-up. Numbers below are illustrative (hosted list: assumed baseline model with Redwood-verified perf; dedicated/private pricing will be different and include commitment discounts).

Inputs (from AeroScale):
- Prompt avg 420 tokens, completion avg 1,200 tokens
- Volume: 75M tokens / month (current), 150M in 6 months
- Long-context split: 85% <=8k, 9.5% 8k–32k, 0.4% 32k–128k
- Target blended $/1M: ~$800

Estimated blended cost sketches (per 1M tokens consumed, includes generation tokens + context compute):
- If we route everything to an 8k-optimized model (and truncate/summarize context where possible): ~ $650–750 / 1M tokens (blended)
- Mixed strategy (8k for 85%, 32k for 9.5%, 128k-optimized for 0.4%), with automatic fallbacks and prefix caching: ~ $1,050–1,300 / 1M tokens (blended depending on caching hit rate)
- Dedicated private pool (committed capacity + aggressive batching, client-managed KV cache): could pull blended to ~$500–700 / 1M tokens at 150M/mo commit (but requires contract + infra prep)

Notes on assumptions and levers:
- Prefix/KV caching: if AeroScale can reuse context fragments (customer history) we commonly see 10–30% token-level compute reduction for long-context flows — this materially helps blended cost.
- Truncation + summary strategies: by moving some 32k flows to a summarized 8k context we can reduce cost but must validate for quality. Recommend test set of 200 examples to measure ROUGE/QA drop.
- Model selection: recommend starting with an 8k-optimized quantized family for high-similarity flows; keep a 32k-variant for the 9.5% heavier requests and a 128k fallback for archival transcripts during batch runs.

Proposed next steps to share with Alex as an email:
1) Offer a hosted sketch showing blended $/1M at current 75M and projected 150M (two-line slide)
2) Propose a 2-week pilot: sample prompt set + 200 evaluation prompts + tuning for truncation/summarization; measure cost delta and quality impact
3) Provide committed-tier pricing for Dedicated if they want to target <$700 / 1M blended at 150M/mo

I'll draft the outbound note and the quick slide. Tessa — any specific sensitivity on the $/1M should go into the outbound (Alex said $700–900 target).

Karthik
Director, Inference Optimization
